items.statement: A source-bounded evidence-supported answer to: What molecular account of propylene-carbonate association with the TEA/DED/BF4 components is supported in the stated mixed-electrolyte context? Determine whether and under which model assumptions the change of cation composition can alter the local PC environment, and what cannot be inferred from that evidence.
items.expected: Accept scientifically defensible alternative methods and evidence-supported support, refutation or unresolved answers. Judge sufficiency for the actual question and claims; do not require any retired V1 matrix, author winner, fixed hypothesis count or particular software. Full points require linked genuine artifacts that sustain the claim; partial points scale with valid question coverage; absent/invalid evidence receives zero dependent credit. Missing research cannot establish non-identifiability. A local finite model does not determine a bulk concentration optimum, electrode adsorption, electrochemical window, charge storage or device energy density. Do not infer those properties from a frontier gap, one optimized cluster or a raw energy difference between unequally charged salts.
